question: Should the experimental core `claws update` plan schema and CLI become the approved host-neutral consent boundary for the subsequent apply workflow?
rationale: This is a new core workflow with versioned output, persisted ownership interpretation, and a security-sensitive consent model; reviewer approval is required to decide the permanent product boundary rather than only patch mechanics.

options.title: Approve the experimental planner boundary
options.body: Accept the gated schema and CLI after reviewer confirmation that the ownership and distinct-consent semantics are the intended core contract.

options.title: Keep the feature outside core for now
options.body: Pause this stack until the RFC or plugin boundary establishes a different owner for grouped update planning.
